tasks.label: Собрать NASM DLL (Windows)
tasks.command: for %I in ("${fileDirname}\..") do (cmd /c "if not exist "${fileDirname}\..\..\_bin\%~nxI" mkdir "${fileDirname}\..\..\_bin\%~nxI"" && "C:\Program Files\NASM\nasm.exe" -f win64 "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" && "C:\Program Files\NASM\golink.exe" /dll /export ShowSplash /g /ni "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" kernel32.dll user32.dll gdi32.dll gdiplus.dll /fo "${fileDirname}\..\..\_bin\%~nxI\%~nxI.dll" && if exist "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" del "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" && if exist "${fileDirname}\..\bin" xcopy /e /i /y "${fileDirname}\..\bin\*.*" "${fileDirname}\..\..\_bin\%~nxI\")
